Software Updates

What's new · MediLab

  • New: Compact All, CT, X-Ray and Ultrasound filters in Patient Records, Daily Summary and Total Earnings.
  • New: Patient-wise Earning Records with date range, procedure names, MR number, received amounts and PDF/CSV export.
  • Improved: 8.1-style patient and centre receipts retain Total, Discount, Net Total, Received and Balance.
  • Improved: Clean blue-white medical appearance, smoother animations and easy-to-read navigation.
  • Improved: Separate Developer Options for protected update server and AI configuration.
  • Bug fix: Windows desktop app uses one native titlebar instead of duplicate window controls.
  • Improved: Backup/restore and doctors directory retained in Standard.

Online update server

Manage the trusted update.json URL used by software updates.

What's new in MediLab

  1. New: Patient-wise Earning Records showing patient, MR number, procedure, dates and payment amounts.
  2. New: Flexible date filters for monthly and custom-period earnings.
  3. New: Direct PDF download, printable PDF report and CSV export.
  4. Improved: Clearer collection totals and month-end review.
  5. Improved: Familiar 8.1-style receipt with visible Discount and Net Total.
  6. New: Word-style radiology reporting, Microsoft Word (.docx) export, and searchable USG templates.
  7. New: Automatic patient/MR details and ultrasound template library with structured sections and optional sample wording.
  8. New: A4 letterhead printing with saved top and bottom reserved margins for pre-printed stationery.
  9. Improved: Radiology report print preview and optional structured result parameters.
  10. Compatibility: Existing patient and billing records retain their local storage structure.
Current version: MediLab

AVAILABLE UPDATE

MediLab update

✧

MediLab checks for verified updates automatically. New versions install only with your approval. Your saved records stay on this computer.

Radiology Letterhead Printing

A4 Pre-Printed Letterhead

Your printed letterhead already contains the centre header/logo and doctors/contact footer. Reserve those areas so report text never prints over them. The reserved margins repeat on each printed page.

Letterhead layout

Top and bottom are reserved, not printed. When printing on the physical letterhead, choose A4 at 100% scale and turn off your browser's Headers and Footers. Print one test page and adjust these measurements to match your printer.

Backup & Data

Backup & data

Export a backup regularly. Browser storage can be lost if site data is cleared or another computer/browser is used.

Security note: this standalone offline HTML uses browser storage and client-side login. It is not a hardened multi-computer server system and is not suitable for storing sensitive patient records on a shared/public computer without additional safeguards.
